H1: Look at these four panels. In any single panel, can you see the large red ridged focus wheel on the side of the cream microscope with two teal stripes on its upright arm? The orange-diamond microscope does not count.
H2: Look at these four panels. In any single panel, can you see the narrow red slide clip beside the glass slide on the black stage of the two-stripe cream microscope? The red ridged focus wheel does not count.
H3: Look at these four panels. In any single panel, can you see the serial-number plate on the underside of the base of the two-stripe microscope? A label on the top or side does not count.
H4: Look at these four panels. In any single panel, can you see the round white front stitch selector with black tick marks on the sky-blue sewing machine with a white zigzag? A visible portion of that selector counts if identifiable even when the tick marks are cropped out. The side handwheel does not count.
H5: Look at these four panels. In any single panel, can you see the small red rectangular front control on the sky-blue sewing machine with a white zigzag? It is below the white selector in a full front view, but a close-up of the control counts if the selector is cropped out. The crescent-marked machine does not count.
H6: Look at these four panels. In any single panel, can you see the service hatch on the underside of the sewing machine with a white zigzag? Its front panel and side do not count.
